from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference/play/users/u098/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    rows, cols = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    separator = None
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != 0:
            separator = ("row", r)
            break
    if separator is None:
        for c in range(cols):
            values = [grid[r][c] for r in range(rows)]
            if len(set(values)) == 1 and values[0] != 0:
                separator = ("col", c)
                break
    if separator is None:
        raise ValueError("separator not found")
    axis, index = separator
    if axis == "row":
        first, second = grid[:index], grid[index + 1:]
        if len(first) != len(second):
            raise ValueError("unequal sections")
        return [[2 if a and b else 0 for a, b in zip(row_a, row_b)] for row_a, row_b in zip(first, second)]
    first = [row[:index] for row in grid]
    second = [row[index + 1:] for row in grid]
    if any(len(a) != len(b) for a, b in zip(first, second)):
        raise ValueError("unequal sections")
    return [[2 if a and b else 0 for a, b in zip(row_a, row_b)] for row_a, row_b in zip(first, second)]
'''
path=programs/'task-7804aa9b.py'
path.write_text(source)
print(path)
